units.source_text: 《史记·秦二世纪》：“赵高欲为乱，恐群臣不听，乃先设验：

en.t: The Records of the Grand Historian, in the Annals of Qin Er Shi, says: Zhao Gao wanted to start a rebellion, but feared the ministers would not obey him, so he first set up a test:
He brought a deer and presented it to the Second Emperor, saying, 'This is a horse.'

units.source_text: 二世笑曰：‘丞相误耶，谓鹿为马？’

en.t: The Second Emperor laughed and said, 'Has the chancellor made a mistake, calling a deer a horse?'

units.source_text: 问左右，左右或默，或言‘马’以阿顺赵高。”

en.t: He asked those around him; some remained silent, while others said, 'It is a horse,' in order to flatter and follow Zhao Gao.
